subject: DISPLAY directive (meaning of compile-time-device-1)
notes: kb/Work PB807 landed (w1004b). compile-time-device-1 is an OUTPUT-capable device-name of the one implementor-name table (CONSOLE, SYSOUT: standard output; SYSERR: standard error); SYSIN and any other word are COBOL2698 naming the devices; several destinations write the line once to each in the order written, with LISTING and the device group each at most once.
